data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the Syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 1.023m. During 2024 there was a gross adverse movement in prior year claim estimates of GBP 0.052m (a modest strengthening). The report provides only a tabulated movement in prior year provisions and does not attribute the small adverse movement to any single named event; overall reserving commentary references a cautious approach to inflation and reserving margins.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions 52 (39) 13 1,145 (859) 286
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
In arriving at the level of claims provisions a margin is applied over and above the actuarial best estimate so no adverse run-off deviation is envisaged.
At 2024 year end, MRSL adopted a cautious approach to reserving in recognition of the inherent uncertainty of forecasting inflationary impacts.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts in the accounts are presented in GBP 000. Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior year movement are taken from the Technical Provisions / Claims reconciliation (note 17). The prior year movement is small and only presented as a table row; no narrative attribution to specific events is provided. The syndicate is in run-off which produces small and sometimes negative premium figures; percentages are derived from the reported total (which is negative in 2024).
